recovery.workingMore: A deal is still working (+{{count}} more)
recovery.dealsFailed: Could not load live deals. One may be working.

agent.wrongWallet: Your browser wallet is {{wallet}}. Switch it to {{expected}} to log in.
agent.notConfirmed: Boros has not confirmed yet. If Log in still shows in a minute, log in again.
agent.noAnswer: Boros did not answer. If Log in shows again, log in again.
agent.replaceBody: <n>{{from}}</n> Boros positions stay open. Its Gate perps show unhedged until you log it back in.
agent.noBuild: This build cannot place Boros orders. Trade the pair in the Boros app.
agent.notApproved: Boros shows no approval for this login. Log in again.

single.maxTitle: The largest order your available margin carries at max leverage.
single.adjusted: Rounded to the venue's price step
single.postOnlyNote: Limit orders are post-only (maker fee). A price that crosses the book is rejected. To fill now, use Market.
single.restsAtSub: Post-only · fills only as a maker
single.partialDepth: Thin book — the book does not cover this size; past it, the estimate is a guess.
single.marginTitle: Initial margin this leg posts — its notional over the venue max leverage

symbol.pickCoin: Pick a coin to see its venues
symbol.searchSymbol: Search coin (BTC…) or paste a full symbol

close.sharedNote: This position holds {{held}} of the {{whole}} on the venue; the rest belongs to another position.
close.hedgesLong: This leg hedges the {{venue}} Long. Closing it leaves that Long unhedged, open to price moves.
close.hedgesShort: This leg hedges the {{venue}} Short. Closing it leaves that Short unhedged, open to price moves.
close.maxOwnedTitle: Close everything this position owns on the venue
close.limitPxTitle: Reduce-only IOC at mid ± slippage. Fills what it can now and never rests.
close.slipInvalid: Must be above 0 and at most 10%
close.bandTitle: Max slippage: mid ± this much. What the book cannot fill inside it stays open.
close.bandHint: Max slippage from mid. Widen it for a large size or a thin book.

execute.viewOnly: View-only: switch to your logged-in wallet to trade.
execute.placed: Limit order placed. {{summary}} is resting on the venue until it fills — see Limit orders.
execute.replayed: Already sent as deal <n>{{id}}</n>. No new order went out. Showing that deal.
execute.marginBlocked: Needs ≈ {{required}} margin (with 5% buffer and fees). Only {{available}} is free.
execute.notMappable: Can't send as one deal. Send each leg on its own.
execute.splitNote: Sent as two deals, one per leg, because sizes differ. Each leg reports its own result.
execute.halfHedged: One leg is closed and the other is still open — the pair is no longer hedged. Retry closes only the leg that failed.

wizard.leaveWarning: Rate locked, perps not open: you carry price risk. The Positions tab will offer to finish the hedge.
wizard.lopsided: The Boros positions differ by {{size}}. Continue hedges only the matched size. The rest carries price risk until you complete or close it.
wizard.oneSided: Only one Boros position is open, so nothing is locked and there is no shared size to hedge. Open the other one or close this one.
wizard.rateChanged: The Boros positions changed. Go back and continue again to re-size the hedge.
wizard.done: Perp legs are being placed. Track the position on the Positions tab.

deal.title: Deal <n>{{id}}</n>
deal.refreshFailed: Could not refresh this deal. The numbers may be old.
deal.slippageHint: Gap between the two average prices, in USDT per coin. Above zero is in your favor.
deal.loadFailed: Could not load the deal — it may have been created by another session; check Limit orders / Positions
deal.resolving: Resolving an order's fate on the venue — nothing new is placed until it is confirmed
deal.convertTitle: Cancel the resting remainder and complete both venues as market orders now
deal.convertTitleNoRest: Complete both venues as market orders now
deal.resumeTitle: Retry the hedge and settle the deal (fix margin/venue first)
deal.crossed: The deal stopped — the limit price was already through the market. Try again from the order form with a fresh limit price.

twap.ownAccount: This TWAP runs on this terminal's Gate account.

area.title: TWAP
area.priceImpactTitle: Impact of the whole size at once, then the sum over all slices
area.needTwo: Set two of duration, interval and slice size.
area.hover: Splits the order into slices sent one interval apart.

server.tooSmall: Too small for 2 slices: {{venue}} takes at least {{min}} {{coin}} ({{usd}}) a slice.
server.tooMany: {{count}} slices. Max 100: slice size at least {{min}} {{coin}}.
server.bookThin: Book too thin for {{qty}} {{coin}} a slice.
server.restUnderMin: Rest {{qty}} {{coin}} is under {{venue}}'s {{min}} minimum. Resume cannot send it. Stop ends the run.
server.hedgeFix: Add {{coin}} to {{venue}} on CrossEx to hedge
server.countLowSize: {{n}} slices. Min 2: slice size at most {{qty}} {{coin}}.
server.countLowSizeOne: 1 slice. Min 2: slice size at most {{qty}} {{coin}}.
server.takerOver: Taker after must be 80% of the interval or less ({{cap}}s).
server.slept: This Mac slept during the TWAP. Nothing was sent while it slept. Press Resume.

lock.running: A TWAP is running. Orders and transfers wait until it ends.
lock.paused: A TWAP is paused. Orders wait until it ends.
lock.error: A TWAP stopped on an error. Orders and transfers wait until you resume or stop it.
lock.errorOrders: A TWAP stopped on an error. Orders wait until you resume or stop it.
lock.unknown: Could not check for a running TWAP. If one is running, the order is refused.

strip.hedge: TWAP paused: {{venue}} refused the hedge · {{what}} · slice {{i}}/{{n}}

run.awakeOther: Keep this computer awake until it ends.
run.borosRefused: Boros refused the close after slice {{i}}.
run.pausing: Pausing: cancelling the slice {{i}} limit and hedging what filled
run.restarted: The app restarted at {{time}}. Slice {{i}} stopped: its rest is cancelled and what filled is hedged.
run.slept: This Mac slept from {{from}} to {{to}}. Slice {{i}} stopped: its rest is cancelled and what filled is hedged.
run.repegRefused: Re-peg refused by {{venue}} · no order resting · price moves again in 1 min

footer.runsInApp: Runs in the app on this computer. Closing this view does not stop it.
footer.awake: Keeps this Mac awake until it ends. Closing the lid still sleeps it.
